name: Kai (castaway)
description: Only character: big round pale-lavender head, thick dark outline, curly hair sprouts, orange Hawaiian shirt with cream red-centred flowers, navy shorts, stick limbs, yellow flip-flops. 24 emotions, 24 poses.

name: Manchineel tree on a tropical beach, midday (close/MLS plate)
description: day; layers: far: pale sky with streaky clouds + turquoise sea band; mid: thick pale-beige trunk with a dark ink outline, red painted X on the trunk, wide canopy of glossy green outlined leaves with small yellow-green apples; near: sand with fallen apples and leaves, soft trunk shadow

name: Aerial view of a tiny lone island in deep blue sea
description: day; layers: single layer (aerial); clouds near the top edge for depth

name: Manchineel tree on a beach in a night rainstorm
description: night storm; layers: far: dark stormy sky + sea; mid: tree with dark canopy, trunk; near: wet sand with puddle splashes, diagonal rain streaks over everything

name: Out-of-focus night bokeh backdrop for close-ups
description: night; layers: single blurred layer

name: Open beach at night in a storm, no tree
description: night storm; layers: far: heavy navy storm clouds + flat sea horizon; near: rainy sand

name: Manchineel canopy over a seaside road (car scene)
description: day; layers: far: sky + sea; mid: tree canopy + trunk, grey asphalt road with white line; near: the red car (asset)

name: Beach at sunset/dawn with the manchineel in mid-ground
description: sunset; layers: far: pink-magenta sky with lilac clouds; mid: manchineel tree left with a tiny red X, low shrubs on the horizon, sea at right; near: pale sand

name: Bright beach with crepuscular god rays (apple scene)
description: day; layers: far: bright blue sky with cumulus and diagonal light rays, small distant island; mid: sea strip; near: sand

name: Under the manchineel canopy with a round bush and grass tufts
description: day; layers: far: sea + sky; mid: trunk with red X at left, overhanging branch with apples; near: round leafy bush centre-bottom flanked by tall golden grass tufts

name: Shallow turquoise lagoon by the beach
description: day; layers: far: blue sky with clouds, tree line; mid: sand strip, manchineel canopy top-right; near: bright turquoise shallow water with ripple lines

name: Manchineel tree with a big stacked log pile (three grades: dusk, night, firelit)
description: dusk → night → firelit; layers: far: sea + sky band; mid: tree trunk with red X and canopy filling the top; near: stacked log pile (≈9 logs) at the base, sand foreground with fallen apples

name: Near-black void with warm under-glow
description: night; layers: single layer

name: POV of a campfire in front of the red-X log pile
description: night firelit; layers: far: blurred canopy + night sky; mid: log pile with red X's; near: campfire + Kai's POV hands

name: Open sunny beach with no tree (ending)
description: day; layers: far: bright blue sky with streaky cirrus + cumulus, low scrub tree line on the horizon; mid: wide sand; near: turquoise water with white foam line at the bottom

name: Manchineel tree (hero prop)
description: Thick pale-beige trunk with dark ink outline and bark strokes, red spray-painted dripping X at chest height, wide umbrella canopy of glossy oval leaves (each outlined, two greens), small yellow-green apples on thin stems. Looks like: Painted 2.5D illustration (AI image). Not a real 3D render.

name: Manchineel apple (small green fruit)
description: Small glossy yellow-green sphere (#f4f16c lit) with a dark outline, a white specular highlight, a thin stem and two leaves. Looks like: Flat illustration with a gloss highlight

name: Bitten apple
description: Same apple with a cartoon bite (scalloped notch) out of the right side, showing pale flesh. Looks like: Illustration

name: Red classic convertible
description: Glossy red 1950s-style convertible (side view), cream seats, chrome bumpers, white-wall tyres. Later shown with paint bubbling/peeling to grey primer with curled red edges where sap drips. Looks like: Looks like a cel-shaded 3D render or AI image with ink outlines

name: Stacked log pile
description: About nine cut logs stacked in a pyramid, round cut ends with rings facing the camera, dark outlines. Later every cut end gets a red X. Looks like: Painted 2.5D illustration

name: Cartoon campfire
description: Flame shapes in layers: red outer tongues, orange, yellow-white core, floating ember sparks, small logs/stones at the base, a warm light pool on the sand. Looks like: 2D animated flame (AE/sprite loop) + glow

name: Round bush with golden grass tufts
description: Dense round bush of small glossy leaves, flanked by tall golden-green grass tufts. Looks like: Painted illustration

name: Bunch of three big soft leaves
description: Three large pale-green oval leaves joined at the stem, held like a bouquet. Looks like: Flat illustration

name: Tiny red crab
description: Tiny cartoon red crab with stalk eyes that scuttles across the sand. Looks like: Flat illustration

name: Botanical field-guide poster
description: Aged cream paper poster pinned to a trunk. Text (top→bottom): 'A FIELD GUIDE TO CARIBBEAN TREES' / 'PLATE XIII' (small caps), engraved illustration of a broad tree, small green leaf icon top-right, 'MANCHINEEL' (large serif caps), 'Hippomane mancinella' (italic), 'Spanish: manzanilla de la muerte', '("little apple of death")' in red, bottom row small drawings 'Fig. 2 leaf' and 'Fig. 3 fruit', fine-print footer (illegible).

name: Leaf in x-ray mode
description: Large oval leaf in 'x-ray' rendering: dark navy fill, glowing light-blue serrated outline, thick pale-lavender midrib and veins, on dark-blue bokeh; blurred dark leaves foreground.

name: Glossy leaf with sap drop
description: Same leaf in normal glossy green with blue-white water beads and an opaque milky-white teardrop hanging from the tip.

name: Skin cross-section diagram with blister
description: Cartoon medical cross-section filling the frame: top dome (blister) pink and glossy with label 'INSIDE YOUR SKIN'; epidermis of pink cells with dark nuclei; white sap tendrils spreading down; dermis pink with wavy fibres, red/purple capillary loops, coiled sweat gland, diagonal hair shaft at left; hypodermis of yellow fat-cell spheres; lamellar corpuscle; red and blue vessels.

name: Satellite storm radar app
description: Dark navy ocean map, dark-green island silhouette, 'YOU' marker (red dot in a white ring + tiny white label), faint concentric range rings, white sweep line rotating clockwise (~0.5 rev/s), white-lavender satellite cloud band drifting right, coloured precipitation echoes (green→yellow→orange→magenta) revealed behind the sweep. Header: 'SATELLITE · LIVE' (teal #7fd8c8 tiny caps, letter-spaced) and 'NIGHT 1 · 9:42 PM' (white bold geometric sans). Bottom pill (#e01436): '⚠ SEVERE STORM' (white bold, yellow triangle) fades in #478.

name: X-ray HUD with Kai's skeleton
description: Glowing cyan cartoon skeleton of Kai (round skull with big sockets + teeth grid, ribcage, pelvis, stick bones), translucent pink oesophagus/stomach/intestines, yellow-orange fire spark travelling down; dark teal-navy background. HUD: 'X-RAY' (#96d9e2, top-left), 'THROAT: ON FIRE' (orange #e8643c, top-right) → 'GUT: INCOMING' (amber) at #1260, 'R' marker, corner brackets, ruler ticks right, 'PATIENT: YOU' / 'AP VIEW · 1:1' bottom-left; legs cross knock-kneed with 3 yellow shake ticks each side 1267–1293.

name: Thermal camera HUD with lungs
description: Kai front view; torso replaced by a thermal-palette view of lungs/trachea (magenta→orange→yellow as the temperature climbs). HUD: 'THERMAL' (golden #dbc87a, top-left), 'LUNGS: 99°F' → counts up to '451°F' (white, top-right; counter 1883–1902), '● REC' red dot blinking, corner brackets, vertical scale bar (white-yellow-orange-magenta-purple) with '500°F' / '60°F', crosshair + temperature tag on the right lung. A horizontal scan line wipes down 1868–1876.

name: Red spray-painted X
description: Bright red (#e22924) spray-paint X with drips, on the trunk. The motif reappears as clean red X marks on the log ends (red_x_marks_logs_f01680.jpg, #cf2627, 1644–1867).

name: 'MILKY SAP' callout
description: White bold caps 'MILKY SAP' with a thin white leader line to a glossy sap bead.

name: Cut-away window
description: A small rectangle with a thick dark outline opens in the splat on the head and shows skin cells, then scales up to fill the frame.

name: Caption style
description: White heavy geometric sans (Montserrat ExtraBold-like) with a ~3–4 px black stroke, centred at y≈900, 1–2 words per card, hard cuts.

name: Sweat drop
description: Blue teardrop (#6488aa) with a dark outline and a white highlight at the upper right of the head.

name: Tear streams
description: Two thick light-blue wavy ribbons running from the eyes down the cheeks.

name: Bloodshot eyes
description: Ring eyes with pink-red whites, red vein ticks and dark pupils; red lower lids.

name: Steam columns
description: White cartoon puff clouds rising in columns from both sides of a red head.

name: Sizzle smoke puffs + splat
description: Small white puffs + tiny bubbles rising from a white splat.

name: Milky sap splat
description: Flat white irregular splat with a dark outline on top of the head, dotted drops around it.

name: Anger vein
description: Red anime 'cross-popping vein' mark.

name: Blisters
description: Pink glossy balls with dark outlines dotted over the head.

name: Frost marks
description: Small pale-blue zigzag icicle marks on the forehead.

name: Rising red heat fill
description: Red-pink liquid level with a wavy top rising inside the head, ending fully red.

name: Scent wisp
description: Glowing green-white wavy line with sparkles curling from the tree to Kai's nose.

name: Soft light orbs
description: Soft white bokeh orbs floating up.

name: Rain + lightning flash
description: White diagonal rain streaks; 2–3 frame lightning flashes (bolt + exposure lift).

name: Toxic smoke cloud
description: Dark grey-brown volumetric smoke billowing up from the fire over the tree and Kai.

name: Cough smoke puff
description: Dark grey soft puff at the mouth corner.

name: Shake ticks
description: 3 short yellow dashes on each side of the knees (jitter).

name: Yellow butterfly
description: Tiny yellow butterfly that lands on Kai's head during 'harmless'.

name: Falling milky sap drops
description: White teardrop drips falling from leaves with splash ellipses on the sand; also on the car.

name: 4-point sparkles / light motes
description: White twinkles on the canopy (scent cue) and around the leaves.

name: Cold breath vapour
description: Faint blue-white mist puffs drifting right from Kai's mouth while shivering (too faint to crop).

name: Fire embers / ignition sparks
description: Tiny orange sparks before the fire catches and floating embers over the flames.

name: Kai's POV hands
description: Two stick arms with white ball hands reaching in from the bottom corners (POV shot).

name: Red X marks on log ends
description: Clean red (#cf2627) X marks that scale-pop onto every cut log end in a staggered cascade (~15 X's), recalling the trunk X.
